root_cause: The v1 Mira-only contract still accepted technically valid image/video/carousel classes and did not require Mira to be the central subject or explicitly reject text-dominant and brand-template-dominant creative. A generic text-led Bedrijfsgeheugen post could therefore remain inside an Instagram-capable path despite the intended Mira-only semantics.
prevention_rule: Instagram accepts only exact-final Mira visuals (image) and Mira Reels (reel). Mira must be the central visible subject in a genuine daily-life scene, proven by vision. Text-dominant, brand-template-dominant, generic company creative, carousel and generic video are fail-closed. Static visuals and Reels use OpenArt; no transport may bypass the gate.

evidence.incident: Instagram showed a generic text-led Bedrijfsgeheugen creative instead of a real Mira visual/reel.
evidence.terminal_rule: Do not claim LIVE until protected merge, required checks, deployment and production/main readback prove v2.
